analyst: Manual analysis using Claude Opus 5.5 for verification and code analysis

servers.server_cost: Available on all plans, no separate fee; MCP does not consume AI credits
servers.linked_cost: Free Forever $0; Unlimited $7 (annual) / $10 (monthly) per user; Business $12/$19; Enterprise on request. The same page also shows Core $9, Business $17, Max $100 (contradictory). Everything AI add-on $28 per user/month.
servers.pricing: Per-user plans; MCP call limits depend on the plan and the Everything AI add-on
servers.restrictions: Calls per rolling 24 h without Everything AI: Free 100, Core/Unlimited 300, Business 1,000, Business Plus 2,500, Enterprise 5,000, Enterprise Plus 25,000 - per workspace and per AI client separately; initialize and tools/list not counted; with the add-on - public API limits; RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with retryAfter, cannot be reset. OAuth only (no personal API keys); rights = the user's ClickUp rights; AI fair use policy.
servers.restricted_by: ClickUp (plans, limits, fair use), workspace administrator (user rights)
servers.governance_logic: 1) Daily call limits per AI client and workspace (plan-dependent). 2) Deletion restricted "as a safety measure for now" - but the tool list contains "Delete task" (the assistant "may confirm") - contradiction. 3) The user's ClickUp rights are inherited. 4) Server-side confirmation and agent action log not described. 5) Connected Search not available via MCP.
servers.actions_comment: 48 according to the Supported Tools page (human-readable names)
servers.agent_cannot: Delete lists, folders, spaces, documents, comments (only tasks); manage members and rights; automations; goals, dashboards, whiteboards; Connected Search across external apps.
servers.docs_recs: No explicit recommendations on human confirmation (except "may confirm" before deleting a task).
servers.gov_promises: Only links to security, privacy and AI fair use policies; no specific promises about data passed to the AI.
servers.user_promises: "available on all plans"; limits "may change", "future restrictions" possible
servers.promises_vs_logic: The "no deletion" statement contradicts the tool "Delete task".
servers.notes: Endpoint https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp; data from https://api.clickup.com (resource_server_origin). Tool names are human-readable (docs); exact tools/list not available without sign-in.

Tools.desc: 48 tools: search, tasks (incl. bulk), attachments, comments, tags, links and dependencies, moving, time tracking, hierarchy, members, chat (sending messages), documents, time-in-status reports
Tools.post: Not documented; on limit: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED + retryAfter

Authorization.desc: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE only; metadata documents published; Dynamic Client Registration (https://mcp.clickup.com/oauth/register); grant authorization_code; PKCE S256; token_endpoint_auth_methods none; scopes read, write; resource indicators supported

observations.text: A limit per AI client (not only per user) restricts the volume of the agent's work.
The contradiction "no deletion" / "Delete task" shows that the documentation and the actual tool set diverge.
The agent can write to people on behalf of the user (chat, comments with @mentions).
